author: Praxis I
title: Dual BRBG: PBVE Auto-Gated PCs (τ=80th) + Balanced kNN (k=48)
abstract: Apply PBVE (alpha=0.5) only to PCs with large per-batch variance deviations (τ=80th percentile) after soft-whitened ComBat PCA64; graph unchanged (adaptive residualized PC50 + equal-quota k=48). Goal: retain mixing gains while improving Cell_cycle/Graph_conn.
